text:
Liam (SRE): Alert: sudden spike in 429s from rate-limiter service in us-west-2 starting ~10:05 UTC. Customers report throttled requests even under normal traffic.

ThrottleBot: [ALERT] Rate-limiter error rate > 10% on rl-service-prod. Automatic incident INC-2024-058 created. Paging oncall.

Emma (Prod Eng): Looking at deploysDid a config roll at 09:50 that tightened the token refill logic (PR#554). Could be related.

Khan (Support): Multiple customers in us-west complaining about failed /v1/embeddings and /v1/generate calls. Marking high priority and collecting affected tenant IDs.

Liam (SRE): Metrics show token-bucket refill interval moved from 100ms -> 1s for many limiter instances due to a misread config flag. Instances that read legacy env var fell back to slow refill causing global effective limit drop.

Jules (Site Reliability): Can we hotfix config? If it's an env var mismatch we can patch the deployment and rollout a fast restart.

Emma (Prod Eng): Applying emergency revert of PR#554 to main and patching live config on the control plane. Commands:
```
kubectl -n platform set env deployment/rl-service REFILL_INTERVAL=100ms
kubectl -n platform rollout restart deployment rl-service
git revert --no-edit 9c7b1f3
```

Liam (SRE): After env patch p95/p99 rate limiter latencies normalized and 429 rate dropped to baseline within 3 minutes. Rolling restarts completed across us-west clusters.

Khan (Support): Sent customer update: "We experienced elevated throttling due to an internal rate-limiter configuration change. We've reverted the change and restored normal behavior. Monitoring continues."

StatusPage Bot: Posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-058 : Partial service degradation for hosted API in us-west-2.

Emma (Prod Eng): Root cause (prelim): config flag rename in PR#554 introduced mismatch between control-plane templating and runtime env var name. Follow-ups: 1) postmortem doc (Emma + Liam), 2) add integration test for env templating, 3) enforce config name linting in CI, 4) add alert when refill interval deviates from expected range.

Jules (Site Reliability): Marking incident mitigated. Monitoring window 60m. If any regression, ping @oncall immediately. :white_check_mark:
